morphology.compounding_rule: Norse dithematic ([quality|animal|resource](stem) + element: Jarn-borg, iron-fort; Svart-vidr, black-wood) layered over Hellenic civic compounds (feature/quality + -polis / linking -o-: Neapolis, Melanoros): the capital Miklagardr (the Great City), Jarnborg (the iron-fort), Thulrs-polis (Thulr's-city).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Norse ruling stock carry the -son / -dottir patronymic and a dithematic lineage-name (the -ungr / -ingar line of the jarl-house); the Hellenic populace keep the -ides / -ades patronymic and the polis/deme demonym of origin; the throne fuses both - a konungr who also bears a basileus-title and a polis-seat.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: sunken poleis and fallen Norse borgs: 'the Akropolis of [name]', 'the Sunken Hof', 'the Haugr of the Jarls', 'the broken Jarlsborg'
patterns.military_units: the Konungr's hird (the axe-bearing guard / Varangian-band) and the polis levies: 'the Hird of Miklagardr', 'the Axe-bearers', 'the Bronze Phalanx of the poleis'
patterns.ships: the war-keel and the long-ship, named in Norse kennings and Hellenic virtue-names: 'the Wave-Stallion', 'Raven of Miklagardr', 'the Nike', 'Pride of the Thalassa'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Amber Kylix', 'The Axe and Olive', 'The Golden Drekar'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - NORSE Germanic reflexes PRIMARY (family_germanic theonym_ancestors, the norse column), Hellenic variants SECONDARY (the Hellenic deity-morphs in achillean's register), never real Norse/Greek gods. Alignment PROVISIONAL (Neutral/Lawful): the Norse war-oath and hird-loyalty meet the Hellenic civic law and the basileus' settled order.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as fjandr (Norse fiends) or -daimon (Hellenic demon), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marhr the War-Brand (Hell. Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame); Vacidus -> Vakr the Unmaker (Hell. Vakidos-daimon); Lusanto -> Lusandr the Hoard-Worm (Hell. Lusandos the Drowner-of-Gold).

holy_symbol_motifs.Geyandr: the standing stones above the olive-terrace
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlund: an iron axe crossed with an oath-ring
holy_symbol_motifs.Thulr: a sun-wheel over a crossed axe and scales

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Hof (Norse grove-temple) or Hieron / Temenos (Hellenic sacred precinct) of [power]: 'the Hof of Thulr', 'the Temenos of Tulrios'.
religion.saints_pattern: the disir and the deified jarls (the war-dead of the ruling house, honored at the haugr / barrow) and the Hellenic heroes (Heros [name], venerated at a heroon / tomb-shrine in the poleis).

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Geyandr (Hell. Gaiandros) - the enduring earth, cold, endurance
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Rjalta (Hell. Realtia) - the mother, mercy, healing
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Thulr (Hell. Tulrios) - the sun, fire, and justice

religion.the_one: Eitnir (Norse; Hellenic Aiternos) - the distant Ancient One, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Eitnir - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eitnir, Thulr the just, Orlund of the sworn war, Rjalta the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers fjandr (fiends) / daimones, warded and unworshipped; the hird-oath and the basileus' civic law bind alike, the enthroned guard and the ordered polis the social ideal
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the disir and the deified jarls of the ruling house) and the city-heroes of the poleis (the heroon-dead); the great powers invoked at the hof-grove and the polis-temple situationally rather than worshipped wholesale

titles._tiers_note: Norse ladder, ascending, with the Hellenic substrate co-titles beneath. Hersir (war-chief / sworn lord) barony over a Hersa-rad; Markgreifi (march-count) march over a Mork; Eparkr (Norse-borne form of the Greek eparch / provincial governor) county over an Eparkia; Hertogi (war-leader; *harja-tugon) duchy over a Hertogadaemi; Jarl (the great earl-prince) principality over a Jarlsriki; Konungr-Basileus (the king, fusing the Norse konungr and the Greek basileus) kingdom over a Konungsriki; Stori Basileus (the Great Basileus, king-of-kings; ON storr + Gk basileus) empire over the Megalriki (the 'great realm'). The conquered poleis keep their Hellenic archon (city-magistrate) and strategos (general / fleet-commander) beneath the Norse crown. The godi (priest) and the Hellenic hierophant stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Old Norse and Greek registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Norse war-elite over the Hellenic poleis: the konungr-basileus and his jarl-kin at the crown, the hersar and eparchs over the city-provinces, the axe-bearing hird sworn to the throne; the archons and the strategoi of the fleets, the agora and the philosophers' schools serve beneath)
titles.heir: Konungs-barn (the king's child; the heir; the Hellenic Diadochos for the polis-line)
